desc.ian_image_library:title: Scaevola coriacea (Dwarf Naupaka)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: Front illustration of a Dwarf Naupaka, endemic to the Hawaiian islands. Dwarf naupaka formerly grew in coastal sites, primarily on consolidated sand dunes, on all of the main islands and was probably never very common. Today, it is endangered.
